text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
This is called the “paddock”. Horse 
girls appear before the race and 
show off to their fans!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Pay attention! In the paddock, you can check 
various factors before you start the race.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
As for more information… Tazuna! 
Give the Trainer an explanation!
